integrity: The unrestricted result follows from a graph-cut parity lemma, an exact join of separated subladder complexes, and a two-cone CW homotopy pushout; the standalone graph-edge verifier passes 44 cases. No independent external validation is represented.
scientific_limitations: The theorem treats single vertical-rung deletions only. It relies on the already published intact-ladder classification. No horizontal faults, multiple faults, equivariant maps, or induced-map normalizations are asserted. Finite checks are corroboration.
title: Single-rung faults create parity-selective spheres in ladder perfect-matching complexes
